principle: Use official benchmark metrics and commonly reported efficiency metrics; do not define a custom weighted quality score or universal pass threshold.

aggregation.average_score: arithmetic mean of the five official benchmark scores
aggregation.average_retention: compressed average score divided by local BF16 average score

general_vlm_robustness.role: separate robustness table; never mixed with spatial scores using a custom weight

localization_diagnostic.reason: FEATHER shows that broad VQA averages can hide localization degradation
localization_diagnostic.claim_scope: diagnostic only unless an official benchmark and evaluator are used

latency_boundaries.model_end_to_end: processor tensors ready through transfers, vision, projector, prefill, decode, and output tokens returned to host
latency_boundaries.application_pipeline: JPEG decode, resize, normalization, layout conversion, model end-to-end, and output parsing
latency_boundaries.kernel_or_stage: reported separately and never labeled end-to-end

comparison_points.selection_rule: Report the quality-efficiency Pareto frontier; do not convert it into an invented pass/fail score.

experiment_scale.development_screen: fixed and stratified subset with recorded seed
experiment_scale.paper_quality: official validation or test split with official evaluator
experiment_scale.performance: at least 100 distinct samples after warmup

evidence_levels.software: quality, token count, theoretical FLOPs/MACs, and GPU timing
evidence_levels.implementation: HLS or post-route resources and timing
evidence_levels.board: measured full-system latency, power, energy, and bandwidth

explicitly_forbidden: custom E/G/Q weighted score presented as a community standard
custom universal quality pass threshold presented as literature standard
theoretical FLOPs or HLS estimates presented as board speedup
revealed development data presented as a new blind test
